item.title: 【Singers/Musicians】young Thug & YFN Lucci Guest On Each Other’s New Albums, Appear To Squash Beef
item.description:
The Atlanta rappers had been feuding for years.
Today brings new albums from Young Thug, who’s back with UY SCUTI, and YFN Lucci, who returns with ALREADY LEGEND. To say these two Atlanta rappers have been feuding would be an understatement.

They’ve been trading words since at least 2017, and in 2022, during the YSL RICO trial, prosecutors alleged that Thug bragged on his 2021 Juice WRLD collaboration “Bad Boy” about shooting Lucci’s mother.

Prosecutors also alleged that two YSL associates “worked to get permission” from Thug to make an attempt on Lucci’s life while he was behind bars.

In the lead-up to today’s two album releases, Thug and Lucci appeared to fan the flames further, but it seems they’ve reconciled.

Lucci guests on the UY SCUTI track “Whaddup Jesus,” and Thug returns the favor on the ALREADY LEGEND cut “STILL WAITING.” “Whaddup Jesus”—a triumphant-sounding mid-tempo trap jam produced by TM88, Marko Lenz, Macnificent, and C$D Sid—is the lighter of the two offerings, as Thug and Lucci mostly rap about taking their ladies shopping for fancy clothes.

But towards the end of his verse, Lucci suggests this song is for the good of his city.

STILL WAITING”—a mournful piano-led tune produced by Kaigoinkrazy and Budda Beats—gets into some heavier subject matter.

In his opening verse, Lucci insists that he’s a real one who’ll lie to police before he’ll sell a friend out.

Lucci has certainly faced his own legal struggles: He was released from prison in January 2025 after reaching a plea deal that led to 12 of 13 charges against him being dropped. He pleaded guilty to once count of violating Georgia’s Street Gang Terrorism and Prevention Act.
item.author: sharenownow
